title: IPU conformance case setup
description: A conformance case's starting state and run limits (E04-31). From reset in `format`: load program.bin, write `registers`, then `xmem`, set `fault_enables`, and run until HALT, a fault or `max_cycles` words.

description.description: What the case shows, in one line.

format.description: The element format (ipu_isa.formats.ElementFormat value, e.g. int8, e4, fp32).

emulator_only.description: True when the hardware cannot run the case: a wide format (fp32, int32) or an EMULATOR slot's instruction.

max_cycles.description: The cycle limit (fault F-9); 0 disables it.

fault_enables.description: Fault enable bits other than the reset value (every fault enabled), by fault label.

registers.description: Every register whose starting value differs from reset, in ipu_isa.registers order. `index` is the register within its bank.

value.description: A scalar register (lr, cr): its unsigned 32-bit value.

hex.description: A vector register: its bytes, lowest address first.

xmem.description: XMEM regions to write; every other byte is zero.
